marketingMath.note: What $100 of advertising buys and what it must do to pay for itself. Prices are 2026 benchmark figures from agency reports, not platform disclosures. No measurement of visits per dollar for a cafe was found, so instead of a made-up conversion rate this block gives the break-even: one extra order contributes $8.50 x 67.9% = $5.77, so $100 is repaid by 18 extra orders: one new regular who comes three times a week for six weeks.

channels.name: Instagram and Facebook ads within a mile
channels.basis: Food and beverage CPM about $8.14 ($8-15 with local targeting); restaurant cost per click $0.72-$0.85
channels.breakEven: 18 orders from 12,000 views: 1 view in 670 must become an order

channels.name: Google search ads ('coffee near me')
channels.basis: Median cost per click for restaurants and food $2.05 (range $1.54-$2.77), among the cheapest industries; all-industry average $5.42
channels.breakEven: 18 orders from 49 clicks: more than one click in three must become an order, or fewer if some become regulars

channels.name: Free map and review listings kept current
channels.basis: Costs time, not money. 68% of consumers want at least four stars; replying to reviews raised ratings by 0.12 stars in the one controlled study

channels.name: Loyalty rewards
channels.basis: $100 of ingredients is 45 free drinks at $2.21, earned by 450 paid visits on a ten-stamp card
channels.breakEven: 18 of those 450 visits must be visits that would not have happened: 4%

channels.name: Flyers handed to passers-by
channels.basis: About 10 cents a printed flyer (my estimate) plus an hour or two of paid time; legal when handed over, a violation when posted (rule card illegal_posting)
